ai_summary: Here's an executive summary of the document:  ABM Knowledgeware Limited has announced its 33rd Annual General Meeting (AGM) for July 30, 2026, to be held virtually with e-voting, noting the absence of proxy facilities for shareholders. Key proposals include a recommended final dividend of ₹1.25 per equity share for FY2025-26, subject to approval and Tax Deducted at Source (TDS), and a plan for five years of commission payments to Non-Executive Directors. Shareholders must update their details for TDS compliance by July 15, 2026, and be aware of the July 23, 2026, cut-off date for voting eligibility.
